name: SpeechParaling-Bench
description: A collection of speech paralinguistic datasets/tasks for detecting speaker attributes and affective states from audio (e.g., emotion, age, gender, and other paralinguistic labels). It is intended to evaluate models' ability to extract non-linguistic information from speech signals across classification and regression tasks.
reputation: A community-contributed Hugging Face collection with limited but growing use in speech paralinguistics research.
